summary: Defines i;unicode-casemap, a simple way to compare Unicode strings without caring about upper or lower case. It provides rules for equality, substring matching and ordering, so protocols that need to sort or search text can agree on one comparison. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Imagine sorting a pile of name tags where it does not matter if someone wrote JOHN or john. This gives computers one shared rule for treating big and small letters as the same when comparing words.

questions: how to compare unicode strings case-insensitively
